children: PennantPark Investment completed a private placement of senior unsecured notes under a Note Purchase Agreement, issuing $62.0 million of 8.00% notes due September 1, 2031 and $2.0 million of 7.25% notes due September 30, 2029. The notes pay interest semi-annually, feature customary make-whole and call provisions, and include a change-of-control repurchase at 100%. The debt is unsecured and pari passu with other unsubordinated liabilities, with covenants including a minimum 1.50x asset coverage ratio. The company also signed registration rights agreements for both series, committing to an exchange offer or resale registration within 365 days, with interest stepping up to a maximum additional 0.50% annually if deadlines are missed.
